viewing_check: Count the prints in the box. Check each for a printed 'Vanity Fair' heading, 'Men of the Day' or 'Statesmen' number, publication date and Vanity Fair Ltd/Vincent Brooks Day imprint (originals, with dot-screen-free lithographic grain under a loupe) versus modern reproduction (halftone dots, bright white paper). Note sitter names; sporting, legal and military subjects sell best. Check the Punch print is a genuine period page.
